user.title: Agent Bridge
user.description: Connect to your Agent Bridge instance.

agents.title: Select Agent
agents.description: Choose the agent for voice and chat.

data_description.default_agent: The agent used for voice and chat by default. Add more agents as separate conversation entities with "Add agent".
data_description.ssl_verify: Turn off only for a self-signed or LAN bridge; leave on for a valid certificate.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Tuning with sensible defaults -- most installs can leave these alone.

data_description.context_max_chars: How much Home Assistant entity state to put in the prompt (1000-200000). Higher means the agent sees more, at more tokens and latency.
data_description.thinking_timeout: How long Assist waits for the agent before giving up (10-3600).
data_description.session_idle_window: How long related turns reuse the same bridge session before the channel key rotates (0-86400). 0 = no continuity; 86400 = the bridge 24h cap.
data_description.enable_streaming: Lower TTS latency by streaming the reply as it is generated. Experimental; falls back to non-streaming on any error.
data_description.debug_logging: Verbose logging for each voice turn. Leave off in normal use.
data_description.caller_id: Registered agent id this Home Assistant presents to the bridge so it can resolve your crew. Leave blank to use the selected agent.

bridge_drift.title: Agent Bridge has drifted from its tested baseline
bridge_drift.description: The bridge reports changes past the integration's tested baseline ({tested_version}): {reasons}. Review the bridge changelog and update the integration if needed. Live bridge version: {live_version}.

user.title: Select a crew
user.description: Pick a crew to narrow the agent list, or choose All crews.

agent.title: Select an agent
agent.description: Only conversational agents are listed (no models, chatbots, workerbots or orchestrators).

data_description.prompt: Instructions sent to the agent each turn -- tells it the request is from Home Assistant and to actuate via its Home Assistant tools.

abort.no_agents: No selectable agents were found on the bridge.
